Date: 2026-05-11T15:12:00Z
Subject: Cloud channel procurement questionnaire — AWS/Azure/GCP sections

Connor —

Thanks for taking our channel questionnaire. We're consolidating vendor docs this week and need the completed AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace-specific sections for governance/procurement review. Key asks:

- Confirmation you support SaaS listing (SaaS/AMI/Bring-Your-Own) on AWS, Azure Offers, and GCP Marketplace.
- Required seller qualifications (tax/EIN, DUNS, legal entity).
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II, ISO27001 (if available), data residency/cross-border controls.
- Typical lead time from onboarding to listing (days) per cloud.
- Any special contracting paths (PO via marketplace, direct MSAs, or third-party billing).

Please attach anything you can (redacted reports are fine). Our procurement cutoff is Friday (5/14).

Oliver
Procurement — NovaBank

[Attachment: procurement_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (requested)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Kane <okane@novabank.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Cloud channel procurement questionnaire — AWS/Azure/GCP sections

Oliver —

Thanks for the clear list. High level answers up front, and I'm attaching our onboarding bundle with the detailed breakdown per cloud. Happy to jump on a 20-min sync if useful.

Quick answers:
- Listing types: We support SaaS (native offer) on AWS Marketplace, Azure SaaS Offers, and GCP Marketplace (SaaS only). We do not use AMIs; BYO is supported via dedicated/private deployment in customer VPC for regulated customers.
- Seller qualifications: US legal entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), EIN: XX-XXXXXXX (we'll provide to procurement securely), D-U-N-S on file.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II (we can share a redacted copy), ISO27001 is not in scope currently; we provide ISO-aligned controls documentation and detailed network diagrams.
- Lead times: AWS: 7–12 business days after seller registration + technical validation; Azure: 10–14 business days (publisher onboarding + validation); GCP: 8–12 business days. Complex regulated setups (Private/VPC) add 2–4 weeks for network & legal work.
- Contracting paths: Marketplace billing (PO/Invoice) via AWS/Azure/GCP is supported for standard listings; for enterprise Dedicated/Private we typically execute a Redwood MSA + SOW and can accept POs.

Attached: redwood_marketplace_onboarding_bundle.pdf (includes per-cloud checklist, sample integrations, and our listing contacts).

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: redwood_marketplace_onboarding_bundle.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Kane <okane@novabank.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cloud channel procurement questionnaire — AWS/Azure/GCP sections

Connor / Aisha / Oliver —

Attached: SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a concise per-cloud listing checklist. Highlights below — please send these to procurement as a single PDF.

SOC 2 (redacted): controls matrix, scope (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31), auditor statement redacted for confidentiality.

Data residency / regional options:
- AWS: Support eu-west-1, eu-central-1. Tenant data and logs can be pinned via region-specific deployment of our Private offering or by configuring hosted-region routing for the Redwood hosted API. Backups & archives can be limited to EU-only storage for an additional configuration flag.
- Azure: Support West Europe. Azure Offers support publisher geo restrictions; we can configure tenant-level data residency for enterprise contracts.
- GCP: Support europe-west1; GCP Marketplace supports region-bound SaaS; for strict residency we recommend Private deployment in customer project.

Marketplace listing / procurement paths (summary):
- Fastest procurement: Marketplace billing (AWS/Azure/GCP) — buyer issues PO to marketplace; procurement approval time is typically shorter because billing and invoices flow through cloud provider. Good for POCs and initial purchases.
- Enterprise: Direct MSA + SOW (Redwood MSA) — required for Dedicated/Private deployments or when specific SLAs/data controls are contractually necessary. This route adds legal review time but gives control over data residency & SLAs.

Docs attached: redwood_marketplace_onboarding_bundle.pdf (previous), soc2_type2_redacted_2025.pdf, redwood_aws_listing_instructions.docx.

Estimated timeline (once paperwork ready):
- AWS listing validation: 7–12 business days post-seller registration; add 10–14 additional days for Dedicated private/VPC work.
- Azure publisher validation: ~10–14 business days.
- GCP publisher validation: ~8–12 business days.

Next steps for procurement:
1) Confirm whether NovaBank prefers marketplace billing or a direct MSA. If marketplace, provide billing contact and PO template.
2) If direct MSA, procurement to send template or redlines; legal will triage.
3) Provide list of required purchaser emails for seller registration.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

[Attachment: soc2_type2_redacted_2025.pdf (PDF, redacted)], [Attachment: redwood_aws_listing_instructions.docx (DOCX)]
